name: Pipedrive
shortInfo: Move data from a data warehouse of your choice to the Pipedrive platform.
brief: Pipedrive is an easy and effective sales customer relationship management (CRM) that drives small business growth.
about:
The Pipedrive Reverse ETL sync enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Pipedrive platform in an automated manner.

Learn more about Pipedrive api documentation [here](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1).
availableSync:
[Deals](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/pipedrive/syncs/deals.html)

This sync can be used to upload deals data from a user specified data warehouse to the Pipedrive platform.

[Leads](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/pipedrive/syncs/leads.html)
